business.title: What kind of business is this?
business.description: e.g. 'a café in Portland', 'a three-person electrical contractor'.

tools.name: library_status
tools.description: What in the library is out of date (flagged for an update or past its review date, most urgent first) and what is due for review within 30 days, each with owner and last-reviewed date, plus every procedure by area. Call it first when asked what needs reviewing or which procedures exist.

tools.name: find_procedure
tools.description: Answer a 'how do I…' question from the library: returns the best-matching procedure's steps exactly as written, with its owner and last-reviewed date. Call it before answering any how-to question, and answer from those steps, never from general knowledge.

tools.name: save_procedure
tools.description: Write a procedure into the library: title, area, owner and the steps in markdown (numbered, one action each). An existing id or title is rewritten, never duplicated, and saving new steps counts as a review. Call it as soon as the person describes how a job is done, before you describe it.

tools.name: mark_reviewed
tools.description: Record that someone checked a procedure and it is still right; it restarts the review clock. Call it the moment the person says it's been checked.

tools.name: flag_procedure
tools.description: Flag a procedure that no longer matches how the work is done, with what changed in the words the person used. Call it the moment a change is mentioned, then offer to rewrite the steps.

tools.name: retire_procedure
tools.description: Retire a procedure the business no longer uses. Its file stays in sops/, but it leaves the library and its answers.

tools.name: list_procedures
tools.description: Every procedure by area with owner, status, file path and review dates.

tools.name: page_mark_reviewed
tools.description: Record that a procedure was checked and is still right.

tools.name: page_flag_procedure
tools.description: Flag a procedure for an update.
